subject: Formatting Differences from Excel Files downloaded from Shiny

messages.author: 9d6705073fe6acfb
messages.subject: Formatting Differences from Excel Files downloaded from Shiny
parts:
Hi,

I am making a shiny app to generate some math heavy documents, with pretty strict formatting. I am generating the excel workbook objects using with the xlsx package, and they look perfectly fine when made and saved locally. Trying to generate them on the shiny server, and then download them via the download button has led to a slight format difference that concerns me. 

In my final version, negative numbers should be expressed with parentheses. So for example negative six would appear as (6). I made my workbook so that all negative numbers are replaced with character strings with parentheses. When I download this wb from shiny however, the style of the negative has somehow been reverted to -6! While this isn't a huge issue for me, it does make me wonder what it is the shiny download is doing to change the formatting of my workbook like that, and if it has caused any other changes that I haven't seen yet. 

Has anyone else seen an issue like this, or know why this is happening?

Thanks

messages.subject: Re: Formatting Differences from Excel Files downloaded from Shiny
parts:
Oh, that's helpful.

I'd hazard a guess that there might be a difference reflected in options()? e.g. save the value of options() from your R console, and save the value of options() from inside your downloadHandler's content function (i.e. shiny_options <<- options()), and see if anything is different.

If that doesn't do it, maybe the same with Sys.getenv()?
